messages:
Anna (Product): FYI -- sales flagged a prospect asking for a bundled reserved capacity + credits offer with a firm monthly commit and a flexible overage carveout. They want pricing, example contract language, and launch-as-a-feature guidance.
Mike (Sales): Customer is a mid-market SaaS with 6m MRR, wants 1 x p4d reserved pool for predictable latency and 2M credits/month for burst. They asked for a 15% off per-token rate on committed usage and a soft overage at 1.1x the committed rate.
Priya (Support): Heard from onboarding that similar asks cause confusion around how credits reconcile with committed tokens. We should clarify how credits apply to streaming vs embeddings.
Devin (Finance): Need to see unit economics. 15% discount + reserved capacity changes blended yield. Can we get expected token mix (chat vs embeddings) and concurrency? Also need proposed invoice flow for credits.
Sasha (Eng): Technical question: does the customer want a dedicated pool (isolated GPUs) or a shared dedicated slab? That affects cost. Also overage behavior: do we allow burst onto shared capacity automatically?
Mike (Sales): They want dedicated GPUs. Burst can land on shared pool but with fallback to smaller model if capacity constrained. They also requested per-token budget alerts and hard stop option.
Jordan (CS): For rollout, we should define success criteria: predictable 95th pct latency under commit, no billing disputes for first 90 days, and docs + onboarding checklist.
Anna (Product): Proposal for intake: (1) define minimal commercial offer to get this done quickly, (2) model blended pricing scenarios, (3) engineering cost & risk check, (4) finalize contract language for credits/overages, (5) documentation & onboarding checklist. MVP should avoid introducing new billing primitives if possible. Thoughts?
Devin (Finance): Agreed. For MVP: offer "Reserved + Burst Credits" with these rules: committed units billed monthly at discounted unit rate; credits consumed first for bursts/embeddings; overage charged at 1.25x committed unit price (rounded). We can model 15% discount, 2M credits, and 1.25x overage to see margin. I prefer 1.25x to protect yield.
Priya (Support): We should also define clear reconciliation examples: include a worked example in the contract appendix showing how streaming tokens vs embedding units consume credits, and how overage triggers alerts.
Sasha (Eng): Risk: dedicated pool provisioning lead time is ~3 weeks. Autoscaling to shared capacity for burst needs a routing flag. We can ship MVP with manual ops fallback (CS-run burst enable) and automate in Q2. That reduces immediate engineering scope.
Mike (Sales): Customer needs decision this week to keep momentum. Can we approve a manual ops path for MVP while we build automation?
Anna (Product): I support manual ops path for MVP if Finance signs off on margin. Action items: Devin to run blended-margin scenarios by EOD; Sasha to confirm provisioning lead times and a short ops runbook; Jordan to draft launch success criteria and onboarding checklist; Mike to collect expected token mix and contract redlines from customer. I'll create intake ticket and schedule a triage call Thursday.
Devin (Finance): Running scenarios now. Initial note: with 15% discount and 2M credits, margin stays positive if >60% chat tokens (higher yield). I'll attach a small sensitivity table in the ticket.
Sasha (Eng): Confirmed provisioning ~3 weeks, ops-runbook for manual burst enable ~2 days to draft. If product approves manual ops, engineering scope for MVP is just the pool creation checklist + monitoring hooks.
Jordan (CS): Drafting checklist: onboarding call, monitoring dashboard share, invoice sample, credits reconciliation appendix, rollback & dispute workflow.
Mike (Sales): I'll push customer for expected token mix and ask them to sign an LOI if we can get preliminary terms this week.
billing-bot: Billing rule created: temp-policy-1865004321 set -> apply credits-first; overage multiplier default 1.25x (editable).
Anna (Product): Next steps recap in thread: Devin (finance) model by EOD; Sasha (eng) confirm ops checklist by tomorrow; Jordan (CS) produce onboarding doc draft; Mike (sales) capture token mix + redlines; I'll file intake PR-592 and schedule Thurs triage. If all green we'll accept manual-ops MVP.
Mike (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll update after call with customer.
Priya (Support): Adding a note to support-runbook to prepare templated responses for billing questions.
Devin (Finance): Uploaded sensitivity results to ticket PR-592 (assume this is in intake board). Preliminary finding: with 1.25x overage, and their stated usage, we'd be ~8-10% contribution margin on committed months. Need to confirm onboarding uplift & expected churn.
Anna (Product): Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. We'll use the triage call to lock go/no-go and minimal contract language.
